missions.title: THE HANDS
missions.desc: No retries on the game over screen. Mikiko and Rhalix against Ultima, for the last time.

lines.t: (whisper) He can track Soul Splitter. Don't waste it.
It's all or nothing. No retry on the game over screen.
(radio) YOU GUYS GOT THIS!!
You better get ready for... THE HANDS!!!

steps.obj: THE HANDS: Mikiko and Rhalix vs Ultima

escape_lines.t: (radio) Lock your feet and don't look into his eyes!

lines.t: Mikiko burns Netsu into Rhalix. Rhalix pins Ultima down.

reply.t: Here's a gift from your sister, Ultima!

steps.obj: Hold Ultima for 15 seconds - the antivirus is uploading!

lines.t: (radio) YOU GUYS DID IT!
My wristband... it broke. My arm hurts a lot for some reason.
(radio) Uh. Probably the power output. Get to HQ and I'll heal you up.

missions.title: Angels, Demons and Gods
missions.desc: Everyone regroups around Sintrie and Technica. Kyrie wants Sintrie. Mikiko is... not okay.

lines.t: Captain! Three super strong demons were fighting like twenty Kyles! One was named Ai Oni!
So it's true. Your name is Sintrie. I have to turn you in for killing Royals.
Mikiko, deep in True Empathy withdrawal, eats the wings Sintrie tore off. His karma jumps.
(radio) The gas that makes demons is made from Skylander wings. C-souls are like demons...
...The Skyhaters. They've been selling wings to the Gov this whole time.
Kyrie - he's my vice captain. He'll help bring your mom back.
Fine. Two years. Bring my mom back - or I tell everyone about you, Sintrie.

reply.t: We're not letting her do it alone anyway!

missions.title: Queen of Section 1
missions.desc: The Royal Council meets. Queen Lovery hasn't come back.

lines.t: Your mother has not returned to her post. Kyrie - you are now Queen of Section 1.
Sorry, Kyrie, the adults are talking.
(I'm twenty.) ...Can I wear my mom's crown instead?
It looks good on you, Kyrie.

missions.title: A New Hideout
missions.desc: Five days later. The Sky Patrol moves into the Royal Capital - and Fox Girl has a cure for Mikiko.

lines.t: Check it out! Our new hideout - and it's part of the Royal Capital!
Good job buying it, Samantha.
No problem, Maxine.
...Guys. There's something I need to talk to you about.
FOX GIRL I'M HOME! WHO IS THIS KAERU GIRL IN MY SWORD?!
True Empathy withdrawal again? Last time it took weeks... I know just the cure.
Fox Girl knocks Mikiko out cold.
I can only put out 5% now. You'll have to upgrade me again, little Yuri.
I'm thinking of joining Mikiko's Freedom Fighters.
...Wait. ZANE?! Where's Zane?! The cameras - he just disappeared!
